accommodation.name: Sunflower Hostel

paymentStatus.note: Non-refundable rate, paid in full online (52.07 USD charged, room total was 45.45 EUR). Only the 7.5% Berlin city tax (3.41 EUR) remains payable directly to the property on arrival. Refundable key card/sheets deposit also required at check-in.

accommodation.notes: Basic 6 Bed Mixed Dorm, 1 guest, 2 nights (28-30 Oct 2026). Non-refundable rate. House rules: age 18+, no children, no pets, no smoking, curfew 05:00-07:00 (front door locked during this window). Refundable deposit needed for key card and sheets.

arrival.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - Arrives Berlin Hbf 12:50. From Berlin Hbf to Sunflower Hostel (Helsingforser Str. 17, Friedrichshain): take S-Bahn from Hauptbahnhof top floor, any S-train heading East reaches 'Warschauer Str.' after 5 stops. Exit station onto the bridge, turn right to the traffic lights, cross and turn into Helsingforser Straße (between 'Veganz' and the railway tracks), walk to number 17.

departure.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - Super Sparpreis Europa (2nd class), non-refundable, seat-bound to RJ 171 (Railjet). Departs Berlin Hbf 07:28, arrives Praha hl.n. 11:25 (~4h) via Dresden/Bad Schandau/Ústí nad Labem. Price: 39.99 EUR, booked via Omio. Ticket valid 30.10.2026 00:00 - 01.11.2026 03:00. Note front-door curfew at Sunflower Hostel is 05:00-07:00, so checking out this early should be fine (curfew ends right around departure prep time) but confirm the door isn't locked when leaving. Bring printed or app-loaded ticket + photo ID.

days.title: Check-in & Bike Tour: East Side Gallery, RAW-Gelände, Watergate & Tempelhofer Feld

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Arrival from Amsterdam via ICE 141 at Berlin Hbf (12:50), transfer to Sunflower Hostel (Friedrichshain), check-in, and get bikes ready.

activities.name: Check-in at Sunflower Hostel
activities.notes: Check in, settle in, pay city tax (3.41 EUR) and key deposit.

timeBlocks.name: late_afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Bike tour of Berlin highlights: East Side Gallery, RAW-Gelände, Watergate, and Tempelhofer Feld (weather permitting).

activities.name: East Side Gallery ⭐
activities.notes: Open-air gallery painted directly on the longest remaining section of the Berlin Wall along the Spree river.

activities.name: RAW-Gelände
activities.notes: Alternative cultural center in Friedrichshain filled with street art, skate parks, open-air bars, and industrial charm.

activities.name: Watergate (Passing by / Spree view)
activities.notes: World-famous electronic music club right on the Spree river with a panoramic glass waterfront view.

activities.name: Tempelhofer Feld (Weather Permitting)
activities.notes: Massive former airport field turned public park. Perfect for cycling down the wide open runways if weather is good.

research_notes.notes: Day 1 covers check-in at Sunflower Hostel and a bike tour of East Side Gallery, RAW-Gelände, Watergate, and Tempelhofer Feld.

days.title: GuruWalk Free Walking Tour, Lunch, Tiergarten & City Center Wander

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: GuruWalk Free Walking Tour through the heart of Berlin.

activities.name: GuruWalk - Free Tour por el corazón de Berlín ⭐ 📅
activities.notes: Free walking tour exploring the heart of Berlin (Brandenburg Gate, Checkpoint Charlie, Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe, etc.). Tip-based.

timeBlocks.name: lunch
timeBlocks.description: Lunch in the city center after the walking tour.

activities.name: Lunch in Berlin Center
activities.notes: Grab lunch near the city center or Friedrichstraße area (Currywurst, Döner Kebab, or local cafe).

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Wander through Tiergarten park and the city center.

activities.name: Tiergarten Park & Victory Column (Siegessäule) ⭐
activities.notes: Berlin's massive inner-city park. Peaceful walking trails, lakes, and the Victory Column at the center.

research_notes.notes: Day 2 features the GuruWalk free tour through the heart of Berlin, lunch, and an afternoon wander through Tiergarten park.

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Check out from Sunflower Hostel, travel to Berlin Hbf for 07:28 RJ 171 departure to Prague. Note: front door curfew is 05:00-07:00, should be lifted by the time of departure but confirm the night before.

activities.name: Check Out & Transport to Berlin Hbf
activities.notes: From Sunflower Hostel (Friedrichshain) to Berlin Hbf: S-Bahn from Warschauer Str. heading West, or taxi/Uber (~15-20 min). Allow buffer given the front door curfew (05:00-07:00).

activities.name: RJ 171 to Praha hl.n.
activities.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - Railjet RJ 171, booked via Omio (order 629543863359). Route via Dresden/Bad Schandau/Ústí nad Labem. Arrives Praha hl.n. 11:25 (~4h). Bring photo ID.

research_notes.notes: Berlin → Prague transport confirmed (RJ 171, Omio order 629543863359).

must_try_dishes.description: Sliced bratwurst smothered in curry-spiced ketchup, served with fries. Berlin's definitive street food, invented here in 1949.
Turkish-German invention - grilled meat, vegetables, and sauce in flatbread. Berlin is considered its birthplace outside Turkey.
Breaded, pan-fried pork or veal cutlet, common across German beer halls and traditional restaurants.
Fried dough pastry filled with jam, dusted with powdered sugar. Confusingly just called 'Pfannkuchen' in Berlin itself.
Classic soft German pretzel, often eaten with butter or mustard.
Braised or roasted pork knuckle, usually served with sauerkraut and potatoes. Hearty traditional German dish.

drinks_and_rituals.description: Tart, cloudy wheat beer, traditionally served with a shot of woodruff (green) or raspberry (red) syrup to balance the sourness.
Pilsner, Helles, or craft options - Berlin has a thriving beer garden and brewery culture.

restaurants.name: Curry 36
restaurants.notes: One of Berlin's most famous currywurst stands, open late, always a line but moves fast.

restaurants.name: Mustafa's Gemüse Kebap
restaurants.notes: Famously long queues for this grilled-vegetable döner - worth the wait if you have time.

restaurants.name: Markthalle Neun
restaurants.notes: Historic market hall with a famous weekly Street Food Thursday event - great variety.

special_meal_formats: Imbiss (street food stand) culture - quick, cheap, and found on nearly every corner, especially for currywurst and döner
tourist_traps_to_avoid: Restaurants directly on Unter den Linden or near Checkpoint Charlie - inflated prices for average food
'Bavarian' beer halls aimed squarely at tourists in the city center - Berlin's own beer/food culture is different from Munich's and usually better value

average_food_budget_reference.note: Rough daily food budget guide for Berlin (per person)
average_food_budget_reference.daily_total_estimate: ~25-45 EUR/day eating casually/mid-range - Berlin is one of the more affordable Western European capitals

practical_tips: Sunflower Hostel front door has a curfew/lockout window 05:00-07:00 - plan late nights/early departures around this.
